headline: NEW CABLE CHANNEL MTV GOES ON AIR WITH MUSIC VIDEOS AROUND THE CLOCK
dispatch: A new cable television network calling itself MTV began broadcasting in the early hours of August 1, reaching homes across the United States. The first image transmitted was a music video by British duo the Buggles, whose song matched the moment with eerie precision. The channel, backed by Warner-Amex, promises continuous music programming targeting younger viewers and signals a new commercial frontier for the recording industry.
answer: MTV airs 'Video Killed the Radio Star' for first time, 1981
